text: Per BMW AG's report for financial year 2025, the direct or indirect holdings exceeding 10% of BMW AG's voting rights at 31 December 2025 (based on voluntary notifications by the shareholders) are Stefan Quandt (0.2% direct, 27.5% indirect, via the AQTON vehicles) and Susanne Klatten (0.2% direct, 22.3% indirect, incl. via Susanne Klatten Beteiligungs GmbH).
short: Holders of voting-rights stakes over 10% in BMW AG are Stefan Quandt (27.7% incl. AQTON vehicles) and Susanne Klatten (22.5%).

source.name: BMW Group Report 2025 (BMW AG), 'Disclosures Relevant for Takeovers', p. 267
source.note: Trailing digits are the table's footnote markers (27.5% footnote 2, 22.3% footnote 5). The page header reads 'the following direct or indirect holdings exceeding 10% of the voting rights at the end of the reporting period were held at the stated reporting date'.
